notes: v517 — the 🗑 delete tools are retired. Deleting a closed trade or a whole holding rewrote your ledger with no record — a losing position could simply vanish and the cash come back, as if it never happened. Alongside v516's Undo removal, that door is now closed in every build: your trading record is permanent. If a record is ever genuinely wrong (a bad print, a corporate action), the honest repair is a 💾 backup: restore an export taken before the problem, or export your account file and have it repaired — keep occasional exports for exactly this. Your automatic on-device backups, the gold ↩ Restore button, ⚙ split/consolidation tools and fee fix-ups are all unchanged — those repair honestly, with the history intact. The lessons have been updated to match. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
